verdicts.originalText: Candace's shield is a brief guard that lasts only during the skill cast — it protects her while she rushes forward (Tap) or braces behind her shield (Hold), then vanishes when the strike lands. It is not a lasting party shield, though it absorbs Hydro damage especially well.
verdicts.proposedText: A brief personal guard that lasts only through the cast, not a lasting party shield. Its extra effectiveness against Hydro DMG is not modeled.
verdicts.rationale: Legitimate caveat kept as rewrite: it repairs trust on a real omission (the 250% Hydro-absorption bonus is not modeled — confirmed in _curatorNotes, no per-element shield-efficiency primitive) and clarifies the shield is a personal, cast-tied guard rather than a lasting party shield. The original violates style rules: it names the character (rule 3), runs ~275ch (over the ~180 target), and spends a full sentence describing the Tap/Hold animation, which explains how the kit works — content players already know and that both windows render correctly. The rewrite de-names, drops the kit-explanation sentence, keeps the personal/cast-tied/not-a-party-shield clarification nearly verbatim from the original, and reframes the Hydro-absorption line from praise into an honest 'not modeled' omission (the 250% figure and the not-modeled status are traceable to the description field and _curatorNotes, so no fact-check is needed).

claimsLost.claim: The guard protects the caster while rushing forward (Tap) or bracing behind the shield (Hold)
